critical_issues: 3-year initial term with no early termination right for Customer
If Customer terminates early, must pay 100% of remaining contract value (potentially $168,000+)
Auto-renewal for 1-year terms with 90-day notice requirement
All fees non-refundable under any circumstances
Provider may increase fees 10% annually with only 60 days notice
Provider can access, use, and analyze Customer Data broadly including ML training
Provider may modify Service features at any time without notice or refund
Provider may discontinue features with 90 days notice and no refunds
Only 30 days to export data after termination
Provider may unilaterally modify terms with 30 days notice
Customer indemnifies Provider for all Customer Data claims
Customer may not reverse engineer or resell

liability_analysis.customer_liability: Unlimited indemnification for data and usage
liability_analysis.excluded_damages: All consequential, indirect, lost profits, lost data, business interruption

early_termination_risk.customer_cannot_terminate: No right to terminate during 3-year term except Provider's material uncured breach
early_termination_risk.assessment: Massive financial risk - essentially locked in for 3 years

data_rights_concerns: Provider may access and use Customer Data to improve Service
Provider can create anonymized analytics from Customer Data
Provider can use data to develop new features and products
Provider can train ML models on Customer Data
Provider can generate industry benchmarks using Customer Data
Only 30 days to export data after termination
Customer Data could be used to benefit Provider's other customers or products
compliance_risks: Customer responsible for ensuring Service meets regulatory requirements
HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS compliance entirely Customer's responsibility
Provider only maintains SOC 2 Type II
Data breach notification to authorities is Customer's responsibility
If Service doesn't meet Customer's regulatory needs, still locked in for 3 years
service_modification_risks: Provider may modify features, functionality, UI at any time without notice
Provider may discontinue features with 90 days notice
No refunds for discontinued or modified features
API changes with 60 days notice may break Customer's integrations
Customer may need to spend significant resources adapting to changes
Feature Customer relies on could be removed mid-contract
contract_modification: Provider may unilaterally modify terms with 30 days notice
Continued use constitutes acceptance of new terms
Customer has no input on changes
Could materially change obligations or limitations mid-contract
auto_renewal_risk: Requires 90 days notice to prevent renewal
Easy to miss deadline and be locked in another year
After 3-year term, could be stuck for additional years if notice missed
payment_terms: All fees non-refundable regardless of circumstances
10% annual price increase allowed with only 60 days notice
Service suspension after 10 days for late payment
Overage fees for API calls, storage, bandwidth can add significantly
overage_fee_risks: API calls over 10K/day: $0.01 per call (could be $3,000+/month for high usage)
support_limitations: Phone: Business hours only (9am-5pm PT Mon-Fri)
warranty_disclaimer: 'AS IS' with all implied warranties disclaimed
No warranty for meeting specific requirements
customer_obligations_risks: Cannot reverse engineer (standard but prevents security audits)
Violating acceptable use policy results in immediate suspension without refund
indemnification_imbalance: Customer indemnifies Provider for: Customer Data, use/misuse, policy violations, end users, breaches
Provider indemnifies Customer for: IP infringement only (capped at 12 months fees)
Provider can substitute non-infringing alternative or terminate and refund instead of defending
ip_concerns: All Customer feedback becomes Provider's property
No compensation or attribution for suggestions
Customer cannot use suggestions in competing products
dispute_resolution: Each party bears own costs initially
Arbitrator may award costs to prevailing party

financial_risk_estimate.early_termination_penalty: Up to $168,000 if terminate in year 1
financial_risk_estimate.lock_in_risk: Cannot exit for 3 years without paying 100% of remaining

rationale: This is a highly one-sided SaaS agreement that locks Customer into a 3-year commitment with 100% early termination penalty. The combination of no early termination rights, auto-renewal with 90-day notice, non-refundable fees, and Provider's broad rights to use Customer Data creates extreme risk. The liability cap ($84K) versus total commitment ($252K+) is inadequate. Provider can unilaterally modify Service and terms. The 99.5% SLA is weak for 'cloud operations' critical infrastructure.
required_changes_to_accept: Reduce initial term to 1 year or add annual termination option
Reduce early termination penalty to prorated refund or 25% of remaining
Limit data usage rights - remove ML training and product development rights
Increase liability cap to at least 2x annual fees ($168,000)
Add termination right if Service materially changes or features discontinued
Reduce auto-renewal notice from 90 to 30 days
Add cap on annual price increases (5% max instead of 10%)
Extend data export period from 30 to 90 days
Improve SLA to 99.9% with meaningful credits (not just 5%)
Limit Provider's ability to unilaterally modify terms
Remove Provider's right to modify Service without notice
Prohibit international data transfers or require specific approval
Add audit rights for compliance verification
deal_breakers: If 3-year lock-in cannot be reduced to 1 year with annual option
If 100% early termination penalty cannot be eliminated or reduced to <50%
If Provider data usage rights cannot be limited
If liability cap cannot be increased substantially
If Service modification rights cannot be constrained
acceptable_for: This contract might be acceptable only for non-critical systems where Customer has high confidence in 3-year need and Provider's reputation is impeccable
